d: NorthEast United FC and Bengaluru FC played out an entertaining 1-1 draw at the Indira Gandhi Athletic Stadium in Guwahati. Jithin MS gave the hosts an early lead with a well-taken finish in the 15th minute. Bengaluru FC continued to push for an equaliser, with substitute Sunil Chhetri setting up Vinith Venkatesh for a dramatic 93rd-minute goal. The late strike ensured both teams shared the points.
